docs.text: Techinical Info Player Tracking Player tracking uses the EarthMC map to find players. Squaremap tracks player in the frontend by downloading a file called players.json , which contains the coordinates of every player visible on the map, every few seconds. This file contains coordinates and yaw for every player that is visible on the map and is formatted in JSON. Coordinate checking This feature is not finished yet! The techinical documentation will be available once this feature is complete.
